steps.en: Install yt-dlp with its default extras, plus ffmpeg and a JS runtime such as Deno
steps.zh: 装 yt-dlp，再配上 ffmpeg 和 Deno 等 JS 运行时

steps.en: Run it on a page URL, optionally with a format selector
steps.zh: 对页面网址运行它，可选地带上格式选择器

steps.en: Matches the site's extractor and lists every available stream, solving YouTube's JS challenge
steps.zh: 匹配站点提取器，列出所有可用的流；YouTube 的 JS 挑战也替你解

steps.en: Picks the best video-only and audio-only formats by your rules
steps.zh: 按你的规则挑出最好的纯视频和纯音频格式

steps.en: Downloads both and has ffmpeg merge them into one file named by the template
steps.zh: 两路都下载，交给 ffmpeg 合并成一个按模板命名的文件

value.en: A page URL becomes a best-quality local file without hunting for stream URLs or muxing by hand
value.zh: 一个页面网址变成最高画质的本地文件，不用自己找流地址、手工合并

sources: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#dependencies (ffmpeg/ffprobe, yt-dlp-ejs, JavaScript runtime such as deno)
